# Read by tools/check_run_matrix.py (per-commit lint; --remote in the nightly watch).
# Tab-separated, seven fields: cell, workflow, job, step (name prefix, or '*' for any step of the job), needle, tier, reason.
# needle: words joined by ' && ' that the step's run and env text must each hold (a binary, a pinned transport).
# tier: per-commit | nightly (a workflow job runs it) | inside:<artefact> (runs inside that suite's cells) |
#       owed:<YYYY-MM-DD> (runs nowhere in CI yet: red after that date) | manual (hardware the fleet's CI lacks; reason = command).
